size:3328:45383.note: The text is the same size on screen as the Design's: the Design's 14 pt on a 375-pt-wide iPhone frame comes out as about 14.86 sp on this 411-dp-wide Android screen, so the two numbers differ but the letters are drawn the same height.

weight:3328:45383.note: The panel heading 「Selected Length」 is drawn bold; the Design sets it in Medium. Every heading in the AI Video Enhance panel is bold the same way, so the whole settings sheet reads heavier than the Design.

padding:I3669:138909;13730:5077;13730:50.note: The pill holds a three-digit balance where the Design draws a one- or two-digit one, so it is wider and its insets shift by 2–3 pt; the gap between the credit icon and the number is the same.

padding:I3669:138909;13730:5077;13730:50.reviewer: The credit pill holds a three-digit balance where the frame draws a single digit, so its icon and number sit about 3 pt nearer the edges; the pill itself is the same shape and size.
padding:I3669:138909;13730:5077;13730:50.reviewer_zh: 點數膠囊內是三位數餘額，框稿畫的是個位數，所以圖示與數字離邊緣大約近 3 pt；膠囊本身的形狀與尺寸相同。

colour:3669:20418.note: The blue time bubble above the trim bar is drawn on the phone (visible on the capture); it is not a text the page source holds, and the time it shows follows the playhead, which is sample content. The capture's playhead sits at the start of the clip where this frame draws it part-way in, so nothing is drawn at the point the Design marks.
colour:3669:20418.note_zh: 修剪列上方的藍色時間泡泡在手機上有畫出來（截圖可見）；它不是頁面結構中可讀取的文字，顯示的時間跟著播放頭走，屬於樣本內容。擷取時播放頭停在片段開頭，而這個畫面把它畫在片段中間，因此 Design 標示的位置上沒有東西。
colour:3669:20418.reviewer: The playhead's time bubble is the same blue in the app; the reading was taken beside the bubble because the playhead stands at another point on this clip.
colour:3669:20418.reviewer_zh: 播放頭時間氣泡在 App 中也是同一個藍色；因為本支影片的播放頭位置不同，量到的是氣泡旁邊的背景。

colour:3669:20449.reviewer: The unselected chip is the same dark grey-blue on both sides; the frame's own image shows that colour too.

colour:I3669:138905;931:2392.note: Both sides draw the same blue Enhance button; the colour was read a few points above the button, on the sheet behind it, because the button floats lower on the taller phone screen.

missing:3313:39358.note: The blue time chip above the playhead is drawn on the phone — the trim track shows it with the playhead's time — but it is painted inside the custom trim control, so it is not a text the check can read on its own.
missing:3313:39358.note_zh: 播放頭上方的藍色時間標籤手機上有畫出來，修剪軌上可以看到目前時間；它畫在自訂的修剪元件裡，所以不是檢查能單獨讀到的文字。
missing:3313:39358.reviewer: The blue time bubble over the filmstrip is drawn and reads 「00:00」; only the time value differs, and times are not compared.
missing:3313:39358.reviewer_zh: 膠捲上方的藍色時間泡泡有畫出來，顯示「00:00」；只有時間值不同，而時間不列入比對。

missing:I3305:34781;4351:19280.note: When the panel opens, the preview bar carries no time label at all: the Design draws 「00:00/12:30」 and the drag handle at its left. The label only appears once the playhead or a trim handle has been moved — the trimmed captures do show 「02:33/12:30」 — so the panel's opening state is missing it.
missing:I3305:34781;4351:19280.note_zh: 面板剛開啟時，預覽列完全沒有時間標籤：Design 在左側畫了「00:00/12:30」與拖曳握把。只有拖動播放頭或修剪點之後才會出現（修剪後的畫面確實顯示「02:33/12:30」），所以初始狀態少了這個標籤。
missing:I3305:34781;4351:19280.reviewer: The current-time and total-length readout the Design draws at the left of the preview bar is not shown when the panel opens; it appears only after the playhead or a trim handle has been moved. Every panel screen caught in its opening state is the same.
missing:I3305:34781;4351:19280.reviewer_zh: Design 在預覽列左側畫的「目前時間/總長度」字樣，面板剛開啟時沒有顯示，要先拖動播放頭或剪輯把手才會出現。每個以開啟狀態拍到的面板畫面都一樣。

missing:I3294:31180;931:2392;325:186.note: Sample content: the Design draws a placeholder here and the app fills in the figure for this clip and this account.
missing:I3294:31180;931:2392;325:186.note_zh: 示意內容：Design 在這裡畫的是佔位文字，App 會依本次素材與帳號填入實際數值。
missing:I3294:31180;931:2392;325:186.reviewer: The credit cost is shown on the button; the Design writes a placeholder there, and the figure itself is not compared.
missing:I3294:31180;931:2392;325:186.reviewer_zh: 按鈕上有顯示扣點數字；Design 在該處寫的是佔位文字，數字本身不列入比對。

weight:3313:39315.reviewer: 「Selected Length」 is drawn Bold; the Design asks for Semibold, which on Android is Medium, so it looks heavier than the Design. Every heading on this panel, the screen title and the credit figure are the same.

unspecced:iv_selected_length_info.note: The information button is on the screen beside this title; it sits a few points further left than the Design because Roboto sets the title narrower than SF Pro.

padding:I3310:38086;13730:5077;13730:502.note: The pill is the same size as the Design's; the balance has three digits here where the Design draws two, so the number reaches about 3 pt nearer each edge.
padding:I3310:38086;13730:5077;13730:502.note_zh: 膠囊大小和 Design 一樣；這裡的點數是三位數、Design 畫的是兩位數，所以數字兩邊各靠近邊緣約 3 pt。
padding:I3310:38086;13730:5077;13730:502.reviewer: The balance sits the same distance inside the pill; the few points of difference come from a three-digit balance where the Design draws two digits.
padding:I3310:38086;13730:5077;13730:502.reviewer_zh: 餘額在膠囊內的位置與 Design 相同；差的那幾點來自 App 顯示三位數餘額，而 Design 畫的是兩位數。

colour:3310:37274.note: Every chip is the Design's dark blue-grey #303B49 and the selected one carries the blue #2589FE outline; the sample for this item was taken off the chip, on the panel behind it.
colour:3310:37274.note_zh: 每個選項膠囊都是 Design 的深藍灰 #303B49，被選取的那個有藍色 #2589FE 外框；這個項目的取樣點落在膠囊外的面板上。
colour:3310:37274.reviewer: The option chips are filled with the Design's own dark blue-grey #303B49; the reading that differs was taken beside the chip, on the panel background.
colour:3310:37274.reviewer_zh: 選項膠囊填的是與 Design 相同的深藍灰 #303B49；量到不同的那一筆取樣落在膠囊旁邊的面板底色上。

colour:I3294:31180;931:2392.note: The 「Enhance」 button is the Design's blue #2589FE; the sample was taken about 50 pt above the button, on the dark panel.

colour:I3294:31180;931:2392.reviewer: The Enhance button is filled with the Design's blue #2589FE; the reading that differs was taken above the floating button, on the panel behind it.
